runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle, blind to diff/plan/src)

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

step_1_wiki_value.claim: Black Cleaver's Carve caps at 30% armor reduction (5 stacks x 6%).

step_2_stack_state_at_event_46.claim: At combat event index 46 the Carve ramp is saturated, so the per-event reduction is the cap, not an average.
reasoning: Carve applies one stack per physical-damage instance on an enemy champion; the cap of 5 is reached after 5 physical-damage instances, and event 46 is far past that.

Stack duration is 6 s and is refreshed by each physical hit; docs/math-foundations.md Sec 2.3(2) states the 6 s duration 'is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS·u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant' — i.e. no expiry window exists inside a sustained fight that would make the debuff absent.

Averaged models quoted in Sec 2.3(2) would give 0.8 x 5 x 0.06 = 0.24, or the exact Cesàro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h) = 5 - 10/46 = 4.783 stacks -> 0.287. Both are fight-aggregate figures; a per-event receipt at event 46 correctly reports the capped 0.30.

step_3_who_benefits.claim: Carve is a target-side armor REDUCTION debuff, so every attacker on the team — including the ally/support participant — is mitigated by the reduced armor. Its presence in an ally-sourced ('support') reduction channel is the physically correct behavior for a roster that contains a Black Cleaver holder.
reasoning: Cached wiki text is target-directed: the stack is applied to 'an enemy champion' and 'inflicts 6% armor reduction' — the enemy's armor stat changes; nothing about it is attacker-local.

docs/math-foundations.md Sec 2.2 keeps the two halves structurally distinct: reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct) mutates the target's R (and Sec 2.1 notes 'Only armor/magic reduction effects can push resistance negative'), while apply_armor_penetration is the attacker-local, floored-at-0 half. Penetration is per-attacker; reduction is per-target and therefore shared by the roster.

The support side of this scenario deals armor-mitigated damage too: Bloodsong's Spellblade deals '100% base AD bonus physical damage on-hit', so an armor shred genuinely amplifies the support's damage — an armor-reduction entry in the support channel is not a category error.

Both items are legal on Summoner's Rift in the cached source data (modes['classic sr 5v5'] = true for 3071 and 3877; removed = false; no champion/ally restriction), so no availability rule withholds Black Cleaver from this roster.

step_4_internal_consistency_of_factor.claim: factor 1.2 is coherent with fraction 0.3 read as the damage amplification the shred produces.
step_4_internal_consistency_of_factor.arithmetic: amp(R) = m(0.7R)/m(R) = (100+R)/(100+0.7R) with m(R)=100/(100+R) [math-foundations Sec 2.1]; amp = 1.20 exactly at R = 125 armor (125 -> 87.5). Nearby values: R=100 -> 1.176, R=150 -> 1.220.
step_4_internal_consistency_of_factor.verdict: Self-consistent for a mid-armor target; no arithmetic defect detectable in the old leaf.

independent_computation.conclusion: The wiki- and formula-derived value for this leaf is a present entry with type 'armor_reduction_percent', fraction 0.30, source 'Black Cleaver — Carve' — exactly the old value. No cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md supports the effect being absent at event 46 of a fight whose roster holds Black Cleaver.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json -> id 3071 'Black Cleaver' -> passives[0] 'Carve' (unique: true) -> branches[0]
sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
Dealing physical damage to enemy champions reduces their Armor

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).
3071 modes = {"classic sr 5v5": true, "aram": true, "nb": true, "ar": true}; 3877 modes = {"classic sr 5v5": true, ...}; removed = false for both

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md Sec 2.2 'Penetration and reduction order: exact composition'
sources_quoted.quote: reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct):   R ← R − r_flat;  R ← R·(1 − r_pct/100)   [flat first, then %] / apply_{armor,magic}_penetration(R, f, p): R ← max(0, R·(1 − p) − f)
Only armor/magic *reduction* effects can push resistance negative; penetration floors at 0 (Section 2.2).

the established model uses a fixed `0.8·max_stacks` constant (with a `hits/2` short-fight branch) ... the exact Cesàro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C − C(C−1)/(2h)` for `h ≥ C` ... The stack *duration* (6 s) is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS·u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant

evidence_limits_and_what_would_flip_this: The exported evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md) contains no golden baseline, no scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster', and no schema for 'support_resistance_reduction' (greps for 'armor_reduction_percent', '"fraction"', 'support_resistance_reduction' and 'cleaver_bloodsong' over the whole export return nothing). The sibling entries [0..5] of the same list are therefore invisible to me.

Verdict flips to new_value_correct only under a double-count/mis-attribution story I cannot source: i.e. if the same 'Black Cleaver — Carve' shred is already applied on the attacker's own reduction path for this event and the support-channel entry re-applied it (0.7 x 0.7 = 0.49 total, far stronger than the game's single unique debuff). Carve is flagged unique: true in data/items.json and is a single debuff on the target, so exactly one 30% application is correct — if a sibling leaf in the same event already carries it, the removal is the fix, not a regression.

Absent that duplicate, removing this entry deletes a real, wiki-documented, target-side 30% armor shred from an ally-sourced channel in a scenario literally named for its Cleaver + Bloodsong roster pairing — which reads as a regression, and understates the support participant's armor-mitigated (Spellblade physical) damage by the ~1.2x factor the old leaf itself records.
